change: Data format unchanged: v3 to v3; SQLite undo schema v1 to v1. Adds computed account and Borrowing and Deposits balances to Overview. No new stored fields, financial-file rewrites or migrations.
backup: No new migration or backup is required for existing registered v3 data. Older unversioned/v1/v2 data still gets verified backup and automatic registration as v3. Imports preserve the original folder.
downgrade: Compatible with 1.0.6 without data conversion. Pre-1.0.6 apps cannot enforce version checks; use a compatible complete pre-upgrade backup before downgrading to those versions. Pre-1.0.4 apps do not implement Ignored tags; pre-1.0.5 apps do not implement borrowing groups.
